title: Insolvency regulator mulls tighter safeguards for personal guarantee insolvency
summary: India’s insolvency regulator is proposing tighter safeguards for personal guarantor cases, including zero voting rights for related-party creditors, independent asset valuations and scrutiny of questionable transactions. Creditors may also have to explain why a repayment plan offers a better outcome than bankruptcy, particularly when recoveries are low.

title: Weekly Market Outlook: Can Nifty find its footing as crude, Fed policy drive markets?
summary: Indian equities enter a holiday-shortened week with the Nifty at a crucial support zone after five consecutive weekly declines. The US Fed’s policy decision, FOMC projections, crude oil prices, global bond yields and foreign flows will drive near-term sentiment. Analysts expect volatility to remain elevated but see scope for buying at lower levels, with the Nifty’s 23,000–23,300 zone in focus.

title: PM Modi, UAE Crown Prince discuss new sovereign fund L'Imad, strategic cooperation; Malaysia ties reviewed
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and UAE Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed discussed the role of L'Imad, the UAE's newest sovereign investment fund, in expanding bilateral ties, alongside cooperation in defence, space, nuclear energy and technology. Modi separately reviewed India-Malaysia ties with PM Anwar Ibrahim, including semiconductors, trade, defence and investment.
